The Middle Lines Kids Bed is a handmade upholstered children's bed with a multi-line panel headboard that gives a modern, designer look. It is built on a solid frame with soft padded upholstery, made to order in our Dewsbury workshop, West Yorkshire, from £285.99 in Kids Single 2.6ft to £350.99 in Small Double 4ft, with free delivery across Great Britain.

Key features

  • Multi-line panel headboard design
  • Solid frame
  • Soft padded upholstered fabric
  • Handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches available
  • Comes with a wooden slatted base

Sizes

  • Kids Single 2.6ft: £285.99
  • Single 3ft: £311.99
  • Small Double 4ft: £350.99

Not sure which size to choose? See our UK bed sizes guide or email us.

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop. Choose from Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé fabrics in solid colours, stripes or two-tone; custom fabric and colour options are available on request.

Mattress compatibility

Choose the size that matches your mattress. Our 1000 Pocket Sprung Mattress and other mattresses come in the same sizes.

Customisation

Pick solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour. Free swatches are available.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90. You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed has a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay.

Compare the Line Wingback Kids Bed, browse all kids beds, or read our kids upholstered beds guide.

FAQ

What sizes does the Middle Lines Kids Bed come in?

Kids Single 2.6ft, Single 3ft and Small Double 4ft.

What is the headboard like?

It has a multi-line panel design, padded and upholstered by hand.

Can I see the fabric before I buy?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available so you can check the colour and feel at home.

Is delivery really free?

Yes, across Great Britain, usually in 3–5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90.

What is your returns policy?

14 days for free returns if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

p1.descriptionHtml:
The Mini Line Luxury Bed is an upholstered bed frame with fine mini line panel detailing across the headboard, which adds a subtle texture without crowding the room. It is generously padded and handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Fine mini line panel detailing on the headboard
  • Deeply padded premium upholstered headboard
  • Wooden slatted base
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £324.99; Small Double (4FT) £350.99; Double (4FT6) £363.99; King (5FT) £383.99; Super King (6FT) £428.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes, and custom requests are welcome. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress or the Memory Foam Mattress.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales), made by our own team, and usually takes 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland delivery is £90. You have 14 days to return an unused, unassembled item in its original packaging, with free collection. A faulty item is replaced or fully refunded. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

What are the mini lines on the headboard?

They are fine panel lines across the padded headboard. They give the bed a subtle texture rather than a bold pattern.

How does it compare with the Multi Small Lines bed?

Both beds have a lined headboard. The Mini Line has fine mini line panel detailing, while the Multi Small Lines bed has multiple fine horizontal lines. Call 07417 439197 if you would like help choosing.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

Can I see the fabric first?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can see the colour in your own light before ordering.

p3.descriptionHtml:
The Mini Line Wingback Bed is a wingback bed with softly padded wings and delicate mini line panel detailing, handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. It balances a bold winged silhouette with understated detail, on a wooden slatted frame. From £298.99 in Single 3ft to £428.99 in Super King 6ft, with free delivery across Great Britain.

Key features

  • Winged headboard with mini line panel detail
  • Deeply padded upholstered headboard and wings
  • Wooden slatted frame
  • Handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches available

Sizes

Available in the sizes below, with prices from the current listing. Not sure which size to choose? See our UK bed sizes guide or email us.

  • Single 3ft: £298.99
  • Small Double 4ft: £324.99
  • Double 4ft6: £337.99
  • King 5ft: £363.99
  • Super King 6ft: £428.99

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop. Choose from Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé fabrics in solid colours, stripes or two-tone; custom fabric and colour options are available on request, and free swatches let you check at home.

Mattress compatibility

This is a bed frame with no built-in storage, on a slatted base that suits standard UK mattresses. Order the size that matches your mattress, or add our Memory Orthopaedic Mattress (from £142.99) or 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress (from £220.99).

Customisation

Choose the size and fabric on the product page, with solid colours, stripes or two-tone available, plus custom fabric and colour on request.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90.

Changed your mind? You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) as long as the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. If anything arrives faulty we will arrange a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed also carries a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.

Explore more wingback beds, the kids version Mini Line Wingback Kids Bed, or our wingback bed buying guide.

FAQ

What is a wingback bed?

A wingback bed has a headboard with side panels, or wings, that curve forward around the sleeper. Here the wings are softly padded and finished with mini line panel detailing.

What sizes and prices are available?

Single 3ft £298.99, Small Double 4ft £324.99, Double 4ft6 £337.99, King 5ft £363.99, Super King 6ft £428.99.

Is the frame slatted?

Yes, it is built on a wooden slatted frame.

Can I see the fabric before I buy?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can check colour and feel at home. Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour.

What is your returns policy?

You have 14 days for free returns, with free collection, if the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.
